bagPolicy.summary: Bags larger than 4” x 6” x 1.5” are prohibited. Single compartment bags, wallets, clutches, fanny packs, and clear bags smaller than the specified size are allowed.
allowed: clear bags smaller than 4" x 6" x 1.5"
prohibited: Bags associated with laptops, tablets, iPads, cameras, and binoculars
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags, parenting bags, and medical bags required for dietary or medical necessity smaller than 16" x 16" x 8" are permitted.

parking.note: Parking options are available near the Fox Theatre, but specific details on pricing and locations are not provided on the website. Visitors are encouraged to plan ahead and consider public transportation or rideshare services.

rideshare.note: The accessible drop-off and pick-up area is on Woodward Ave. between Montcalm St. and Columbia St.

concessions.note: Little Caesars Arena offers a variety of food options including arena classics, chicken dishes, grilled items, and signature Little Caesars pizza. There are pop-up stands and four main restaurants: Mike's Pizza Bar, PointsBet Sports Bar, and The UWM District Market.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The sensory room is designed to be fully accessible, accommodating individuals of all abilities and ages, with features such as wheelchair accessibility. The sensory room is located on the upper concourse, across from PORTAL 66, next to First Aid.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Do not exit with the expectation to re-enter the venue after scanning of tickets.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call is located at the Fox Theatre Box Office. The most up-to date Box Office hours for The Fox Theatre can be found at 313Presents.com/BoxOffice.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Fox Theatre Detroit. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
